notes: LHS 236 is a published sdK7 with high-resolution abundance measurements. Gaia and historical velocities are consistent within the approximate 20 km/s uncertainty of the old method. ASAS-SN standard photometry is vulnerable to the proper-motion displacement.

findings.summary: The optical color flag has a published spectroscopic explanation.
